Position: Registered Dietitian- M Surgical - Clinical Nutrition

Status:  Full-time

Number of Vacancies: 1

Department: M Surgical - Clinical Nutrition

Role Level: AH10.21 $45.04- $57.26

Site: Mississauga Hospital Site

Work Model: On-Site

Hours of Work/Shift: Mon-Fri, 07.30-15.30 

Posted: October 20, 2026

Internal Deadline: October 27, 2026

 Trillium Health Partners is one of Canada’s largest community-based teaching hospitals, serving the growing and diverse populations of Mississauga, West Toronto, and surrounding communities through the Credit Valley Hospital, the Mississauga Hospital, the Queensway Health Centre, the Reactivation care Centre (Church Site) and the new THP-UHN Reactivation Care Centre. Guided by our values of compassion, excellence, and courage, and through our strategic roadmap, Plan to 2030, we are creating a new kind of health care - defined not by illness, but by the health and well-being of people and communities.

Key Qualifications

  • Degree in Human Nutrition and Dietetics combined with surgical experience preferred
  • Current registration with the College of Dietitians of Ontario is required
  • Ideally possesses membership with Dietitians of Canada
  • Established clinical skills in nutritional management of medical and complex patients
  • Experienced in the management of enteral and parenteral nutrition support
  • Reliable, flexible, creative, self-directed professional, able to work effectively and collaboratively within a team environment
  • Effective interpersonal, organizational and communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize practice-based research to ensure excellence in the provision of nutritional care.
  • Proficiency in computer Windows software applications, REACH portal, Meditech.
  • One to two years recent experience with established clinical skills in an inpatient acute care setting 

Position Summary:

  • Cross-training and coverage to other inpatient medical-surgical units as needed
  • Provide quality nutrition care therapy in relation to the patient's diagnosis, treatment, age, and nutrition status in an inpatient setting
  • Provide screening and assessment, contribute to care plan development, establish goal-oriented treatment interventions, patient/family education and provide support to address nutritional needs
  • Educate patients and family members on individual basis
  • Act as a coach/mentor/consultant using sound critical thinking skills to achieve patient outcomes.
  • Act as a coach/mentor for dietetic interns and other students as appropriate
  •  participate in interprofessional care team functions, including daily rounds

 

 

To pursue this career opportunity, please visit our website: www.trilliumhealthpartners.ca
